Requirement_Name: The system shall display the list of all product categories with category code, name, and total active product count.
The system shall allow Warehouse Staff to create a new category with unique name and description.
The system shall allow Warehouse Staff to update existing category information.
The system shall allow category deletion only when `BR-CAT-01` is satisfied (zero associated products); otherwise reject with an error message.
The system shall display a filtered and paginated product list with SKU, name, category, unit, image, and total available inventory across batches.
The system shall allow Warehouse Staff to create a new product specifying SKU, name, category, unit of measurement, description, and images (`BR-CAT-02`).
The system shall allow updating product specifications, images, and descriptions.
The system shall allow marking products as inactive or deleting products that have no historical transaction records.
The system shall list all suppliers with supplier code, name, phone, address, and partnership status.
The system shall allow creating a new supplier with validated tax ID/phone and contact person.
The system shall allow updating supplier contact and address information.
The system shall enforce `BR-SUP-02`, prohibiting deletion of suppliers with existing Goods Receipts and allowing status change to Inactive only.
The system shall display the history of Goods Receipts with receipt ID, date, supplier name, line count, total amount, and creator.
The system shall allow Warehouse Staff to create a Goods Receipt, selecting a supplier and adding items with Batch No, MFG, EXP, Qty, and Unit Price (`BR-GR-01`).
The system shall validate $\text{EXP} > \text{MFG}$ and $\text{EXP} \ge \text{Receipt Date} + 3\text{ days}$ for all perishable items (`BR-GR-02`).
The system shall calculate line totals and receipt totals automatically without manual overrides (`BR-GR-03`).
The system shall prohibit modification or deletion of Goods Receipts once associated batch items have been sold, reserved, or disposed (`BR-GR-04`).
The system shall maintain real-time inventory quantity per individual batch (`Batch Inventory`).
The system shall allow Warehouse Staff to set and update the retail selling price independently for each batch (`BR-BAT-01`).
The system shall allow Warehouse Staff to apply clearance discount percentages (10%–50%) to older batches nearing expiration (`BR-BAT-04`).
The system shall allow Warehouse Staff to set the sale status of newly imported batches to "Delayed" or "Active" (`BR-BAT-03`).
The system shall run an automated daily routine to delist any batch where $\text{Current Date} \ge \text{EXP}$ (`BR-EXP-01`).
The system shall provide an Expired Stock Disposal function allowing staff to record condemned batch quantities, reasons, and deduct inventory (`BR-EXP-02`).
The system shall allow users to browse products grouped by New Arrivals, Best Sellers, Promotions, and Categories.
The system shall provide keyword search on product names returning matches within $\le 500\text{ ms}$ (`NFR-PERF-03`).
The system shall display product details including high-resolution images, description, origin, organic certification, active batch selling price, and discount tag.
The system shall allow users to add items to a persistent cart, update quantities, or remove items.
The system shall validate cart items against active batch inventory, preventing selection of quantities exceeding available stock.
The system shall allow customers to log in via Google OAuth 2.0 and Facebook Login.
On first-time social login, the system shall prompt the customer for Full Name, Phone Number, Email, and Initial Delivery Address (`BR-AUTH-02`).
The system shall transmit a 6-digit OTP code to the customer's phone via SMS Brandname, validating input within a 3-minute expiration window (`BR-AUTH-02`).
The system shall allow customers to view and update their profile and maintain a personal address book.
The system shall default the checkout shipping address to the customer's most recently completed order address (`BR-AUTH-03`).
At checkout, the system shall compute driving distance $d$ from the store to the selected address. If $d > 10\text{ km}$, the order shall be rejected with an explanatory notification (`BR-DEL-01`).

The system shall compute tiered delivery fees automatically based on distance: $10,000\text{ VND}$ ($<1\text{ km}$), $20,000\text{ VND}$ ($1\text{ to }<3\text{ km}$), $30,000\text{ VND}$ ($3\text{ to }10\text{ km}$) (`BR-DEL-02`).
Upon order submission, the system shall allocate inventory following FEFO order (`BR-BAT-02`) and place immediate atomic reservations on batches (`BR-ORD-01`).
The system shall support Cash on Delivery (COD) payment, recording order status as `Pending`.
For VietQR payment, the system shall render a dynamic QR code containing exact amount and Order ID. Upon receiving verified SePay webhook, status shall transition to `Paid` (`BR-ORD-03`).
The system shall display the customer's order history with tracking statuses: `Pending`, `Processing`, `In Delivery`, `Delivered`, `Cancelled`, `Delivery Failed`.
The system shall allow customers to cancel orders that are in `Pending` or `Processing` status, immediately releasing batch reservations (`BR-ORD-04`, `BR-ORD-05`).
The system shall enable rating (1–5 stars) and reviews only for orders in `Delivered` status (`BR-FB-01`).
The system shall provide a "Re-Order" action that maps items from a previous order into the current cart using currently available batches and prevailing prices (`BR-RE-01`).
The system shall display an incoming order queue for Sales Staff, highlighting first-time customer orders.
For first-time customer orders, the system shall require Sales Staff to confirm that telephone verification has been conducted before advancing order status (`BR-FUL-01`).
The system shall provide a one-click print function generating formatted Invoices and Packing Slips sent to the store receipt printer (`BR-FUL-02`).
The system shall allow Sales Staff to assign an order to a delivery staff member and transition status to `In Delivery`.
The system shall allow confirming delivery success (`Delivered`), permanently deducting batch stock and recording financial revenue (`BR-FUL-03`).
In case of delivery failure, the system shall allow recording failure reasons (`Delivery Failed`) and initiating warehouse restocking inspection (`BR-FUL-04`).
The system shall allow Sales Staff to publish rich-text articles and cooking recipes with images.
The system shall allow Sales Staff to edit, delete, hide outdated articles, and unhide previously hidden articles.
The storefront shall render active articles for guest and customer viewing.
The system shall generate Revenue Reports aggregated by day, week, month, or custom date ranges with breakdown by product category (`BR-REP-01`).
The system shall generate Real-Time Stock Reports showing quantity on hand, reserved stock, and days remaining until expiration per batch.
The system shall generate Expired Stock Disposal Reports detailing destroyed quantities and financial loss values.
The system shall trigger visual low-stock alerts when batch inventory drops below defined minimum thresholds.
The system shall allow exporting all report tables to Excel (.xlsx) and PDF formats.
The system shall allow the Store Owner to create staff user accounts and assign roles (`Sales Staff`, `Warehouse Staff`).
The system shall allow the Store Owner to immediately revoke staff account access, terminating active sessions within $\le 1.0\text{ s}$ (`BR-SEC-03`).
The system shall enforce role-based access control granting the Store Owner unrestricted access to all system functions (`BR-SEC-02`).
